# Oceanid

Oceanid is one app for life at sea.

Oceanid helps captains, travelers, marinas, and marine service providers plan trips, open cabins to verified travelers, connect with services, and book marina support before arrival.

## Primary Site

- https://oceanid.io/

## Key Topics

- Yacht trip planning
- Shared yacht cabin access
- Verified maritime travelers
- Marina service discovery and booking
- Marine service provider visibility
- Life at sea mobile app

## Preferred Description

Oceanid is a mobile app for life at sea, built for captains, travelers, marinas, and service providers. It brings trip planning, cabin sharing, verified traveler access, and marina services into one place.
